provenance.title: NESO Clean Power 2030 economic zones (the 17 zones of chart CP.08), as polygons
provenance.source: NESO, Clean Power 2030 Data Workbook V003 (data/CP30/Clean Power 2030 Data Workbook_V003.xlsx), chart CP.08 'Network constraint heat maps': the four zone heat-map images embedded in the workbook (xl/media/image2.png: network we have today, FFR and ND panels; xl/media/image3.png: network we are recommending, FFR and ND panels)
provenance.method: Decoded 16 Oct 2026: each image pixel's colour matched to the matplotlib 'Reds' scale; a pixel is zone z when its colour index in all four panels equals the index implied by CP.08's published TWh for zone z (CP.08!P11:P78, 'over 10 TWh' as the darkest colour); unassigned land pixels filled from the nearest assigned pixel within 4 px; the raster georeferenced to WGS84 by a scale-and-offset fit of the map outline (lon = -19.1656 + 0.035811 x px, lat = 62.7199 - 0.020532 x py; fit IoU 0.873) and vectorised. Zone numbering and labels are CP.08's.
provenance.accuracy: About 2-4 km at zone borders (image resolution). Used by scripts/CP30/balancing_validation.py, which zones buses by these polygons (nearest polygon offshore, the network graph for remote offshore buses) and then reconciles each bus with its side of the zone-defining ETYS boundaries (B1a, B2, B4, B6, B7a, B8, B9, EC5, LE1, SW1, B13), so a border error cannot put a bus on the wrong side of a boundary.
